app.name: Bakery Ops
app.tagline: Orders, kitchen, bakery, stock and shifts in one place
app.phase_notice: Phase 0: sign-in, the catalog and people work today. The other screens arrive phase by phase.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Use the phone number and password your admin gave you.

pad.title: Waiter pad
pad.lock_idle: The pad locked after a minute without a touch.
pad.lock_expired: Your session ended. Enter your code again.
pad.no_tables: No tables are set up. Ask a manager.
pad.takeaway_note: A takeaway order needs no table.
pad.cart_empty: Nothing added yet. Tap a product to add it.
pad.sent: Order sent. It is on your list.
pad.shortfall_hint: Not enough stock. Reduce or remove this line, then send again.
pad.stale: Cannot reach the server. Showing what was loaded; it may be out of date.

till.title: Cashier till
till.queue_empty: No orders are waiting for payment.
till.stale: Cannot reach the server. Showing what was loaded; it may be out of date.
till.sent: Order sent. It is in the queue.
till.cash_short: The cash received does not cover this amount.
till.void_intro: A void needs the PIN of a manager or admin. The stock held for the order is released.
till.pay_blocked_no_shift: Start the till shift before taking a payment.
till.pay_blocked_not_open: The till shift is not open (its opening or closing count is in progress).
till.offline_notice: This till is offline. Complete the payment once the connection is back: nothing on this sheet is lost.
till.network_kept: Nothing was lost: the sheet and its photos are kept. Try again when the connection is back; trying again cannot take the money twice.
till.block_label: Why the payment cannot be completed yet
till.block_nothing_due: Nothing is left to pay on this order.
till.block_too_many_rows: At most {max} payments can be taken together.
till.issue_cash_short: enter the cash received; it must cover the amount
till.issue_reference_invalid: the reference number does not match the expected format
till.issue_photo_missing: take the photo of the receipt
till.issue_photo_uploading: wait until the photo is uploaded
till.issue_photo_failed: the photo was not uploaded, try again
till.block_short: The payments are {amount} {currency} short of the amount due.
till.block_over: The payments are {amount} {currency} more than the amount due.
till.amount_invalid: Type an amount such as 120 or 120.50.
till.amount_zero: The amount must be above zero.
till.reference_hint_default: As shown on the receipt or the confirmation message.
till.reference_invalid: This does not look like a {channel} reference. Check it against the receipt.
till.photo_take: Take a photo of the receipt
till.receipt_link_copied: Copied. Send it to the customer.
till.receipt_link_copy_by_hand: Copy the link from here and send it to the customer.
till.void_payment_intro: Voiding a payment takes its money off the order, which is owed it again. It needs the PIN of a manager or admin. A closed order is refunded instead.
till.void_whole_order: The whole order (the stock held for it is released)
till.closed_intro: Orders closed lately, newest first. A refund needs a manager's PIN.

kds.no_kitchen_station: No kitchen station is assigned to you. Ask an admin.
kds.no_bar_station: No bar station is assigned to you. Ask an admin.
kds.stale: Cannot reach the server. Showing the last tickets; they may be out of date.

stations.strip_stale: Cannot reach the server. Showing the last figures; they may be out of date.
stations.strip_no_place: This station has no stock place of its own.
stations.case_stale: Cannot reach the server. Showing the last figures; they may be out of date.
stations.case_no_place: This branch has no display case.

production.title: Production board
production.intro: Requests from stock-outs and the plan, in the order to work them. Open a card to see the recipe and what is on hand.
production.stale: Cannot reach the server. Showing the last board; it may be out of date.
production.no_recipe: This product has no active recipe, so nothing can be worked out for it.
production.no_stock_place: This station has no stock place, so what is on hand cannot be shown.
production.done_hint: Enter what was made and what was thrown away, in {unit}.
production.need_qty: Enter a number such as 6 or 2.5.
production.need_something: Produced and waste cannot both be zero.
production.waiting_overseer: Waiting for an overseer to confirm the batch.
production.send_back_need_note: Write a note for the baker.
production.transfer_sent: Transfer requested. The store keeper will confirm it.

transfer.title: Request transfer: {name}
transfer.sent: Transfer requested. The store keeper will confirm it.
transfer.need_qty: Enter a number such as 6 or 2.5.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.intro: Set up what the bakery buys and sells, and who works here.
admin.catalog_desc: Ingredients and products with their categories and units.
admin.no_access: Your account cannot open this page. Ask an admin.
admin.orders_desc: Every active order with its lines, stations and timeline, live.
admin.inventory_desc: Stock, the ledger, purchases and suppliers, transfers, reorder rules and alerts.
admin.planner_desc: Schedule a night's production, set due times and priorities, and hand requests to a baker.
admin.shifts_desc: Running shifts, templates and the roster calendar, counts waiting for approval, locked history with fingerprints, and replay.
admin.payments_desc: Every payment with its receipt photo, verify and dispute, the day-by-day reconciliation, the payment methods and the receipt.
admin.analytics_desc: Sales, payment methods, products, stations, staff and shifts over any range, with exports; everyone sees their own figures.
admin.audit_desc: Who changed what, when and where, with each entry's before and after; export for the admin.

adminOrders.title: Orders
adminOrders.intro: Every active order of the branch, live. Open one to read its timeline.
adminOrders.stale: Cannot reach the server. Showing what was loaded; it may be out of date.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.intro: Everything the bakery buys and sells, each named in English and in Amharic.
catalog.field_restock: Goes back to stock when refunded
catalog.refundable_hint: Whether this product may be refunded at all.
catalog.restock_hint: A refunded one is put back into stock, as a cake from the display case.
catalog.restock_off_to_order: A product made to order uses up its ingredients: it never goes back to stock.
catalog.restock_off_ingredient: An ingredient is never sold, so it never goes back to stock.
catalog.refund_settings_intro: Decide whether this product can be refunded and whether a refunded one goes back into stock.
catalog.refund_read_only: Only the admin changes these settings.

people.title: People
people.intro: Everyone who signs in to Bakery Ops in this branch.
people.password_hint: At least 8 characters. Give it to the person privately.
people.stations_intro: Where work is done. When a station requires an overseer, a batch made there waits for sign-off before the stock moves.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.session_expired: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.body: There is no page at this address.

outbox.pending: {count, plural, one {# change waiting to send} other {# changes waiting to send}}

bell.title: Notifications
bell.stale: Cannot reach the server. These notifications may be out of date.
bell.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
bell.enable_denied: Notifications are blocked in this browser. Allow them in the browser settings.
bell.enable_unsupported: This device cannot receive push notifications.

stock.title: Stock
stock.intro: What each place holds: on hand, reserved and available, in the base unit of the item.
stock.no_places: No place is set up yet.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.intro: Every stock movement, newest first. The ledger is never edited; a correction is a new row.
ledger.reason_hint: Filters the rows on this page only.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.intro: Who the bakery buys from. A supplier is never deleted; switching one off keeps its history and removes it from the choice on a new purchase.
suppliers.name: Name

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.intro: A purchase starts as a draft. Confirming it puts the stock into the receiving place and moves the moving average cost of each item.
purchases.allow_duplicate: This is a different delivery: allow the duplicate invoice number
purchases.confirmed_note: Purchase confirmed. The stock is in the receiving place.
purchases.cost_before: Average cost before, per base unit
purchases.cost_after: Average cost after, per base unit
purchases.error_item: Choose an item and a unit.
purchases.error_cost: Enter the unit cost as a number (for example 40.50).
purchases.error_no_lines: At least one line is needed.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.intro: Stock that stations asked the store for. Confirming moves the stock; rejecting needs a reason.
transfers.source_short: Not enough at the source: {qty} available
transfers.reason_hint: The person who asked will see it.

reorder.title: Reorder
reorder.intro: The rules that say how little of an item is too little and how much to order then, and the list they produce.
reorder.list_empty: Nothing is at or under its minimum.
reorder.place_hint: Whole branch counts the item's stock in every place.
reorder.notify_hint: If none is chosen, the default roles are told.
reorder.error_min: Enter the minimum quantity as a number (for example 25).
reorder.delete_about: The rule for {item} will be deleted. Continue?

recipe.intro: Price, cost and margin, and every version of the recipe.
recipe.not_a_product: Only products have recipes. Ingredients are bought and stocked.
recipe.bought_in: A bought-in product is sold as it comes and has no recipe.
recipe.no_recipe: This product has no recipe yet. Save the first version below.
recipe.cost_unavailable: The cost could not be read for this version.
recipe.cost_lines: Cost of version {version}, line by line
recipe.start_from: Start a new version from version {version}
recipe.note_hint: Say what changed and why. Everyone sees it in the history.
recipe.check_yield: Enter a yield above zero, with at most 4 decimals.
recipe.check_lines: Every ingredient needs a unit and a quantity above zero, with at most 4 decimals.
recipe.check_waste: Waste is a percentage from 0 up to, but not including, 100, with at most 2 decimals.
recipe.check_steps: Write each step in both languages, or leave it out.
recipe.check_preview: Enter a quantity with at most 4 decimals.
recipe.preview_note: Preview, computed in this browser from the draft on the left, as entered. A real request shows the server's figures on its production card.
recipe.compare_none: Publish a second version to compare costs.

planner.title: Production planner
planner.intro: Open production requests with their due times and priorities. Schedule a night's work and hand each request to a baker.
planner.qty_hint: Leave empty for the batch size: {qty} {unit}.
planner.qty_hint_none: In the product's base unit. Leave empty for the batch size.
planner.check_product: Choose a product that is made in batches.
planner.check_qty: Enter a quantity above zero, with at most 4 decimals, or leave it empty.
planner.assign_needs_people: Naming a baker needs permission to manage people. Ask an admin to assign.

shifts.idle_hint: Start the shift and count the stock first, or start without counting when last night's count is not approved yet.
shifts.notes: {count, plural, one {# handover note} other {# handover notes}}
shifts.close_body: Closing the shift freezes this station's stock until the closing count is submitted. Make sure the open orders are finished.
shifts.stale: Cannot reach the server. The shift shown may be out of date.
shifts.stations_intro: Where each station stands right now.
shifts.stations_none: There are no stations to show.
shifts.cash_last_float_hint: What the last shift left for this one
shifts.cash_last_float_none: No closing has left a float yet
shifts.cash_none_yet: No payment taken yet in this shift.
shifts.drawer_intro: Count the notes and coins in the drawer before the shift opens.
shifts.drawer_none: This shift has no drawer count to declare.

counts.title: Shift count
counts.intro: Count what is on the shelves, place by place. Anything that differs from what is expected needs a reason.
counts.no_shift: This link does not name a shift. Open the count from the station's shift bar.
counts.no_count: This link does not name a count. Open it from the list of counts waiting for a decision.
counts.stage_waiting_cosign: Handed in. Waiting for an overseer to co-sign.
counts.stage_waiting_approval: Handed in. Waiting for a manager to approve.
counts.stage_sent_back: This count was sent back. A new attempt has been started.
counts.sent_back_hint: Count the lines again. They are filled in with your earlier figures.
counts.reopened: An admin reopened this count to correct it.
counts.blocked_by_pending: Another count at this place is still waiting for a decision. This one can be filled in but not handed in until that is decided.
counts.no_lines: There is nothing to count at this place.
counts.nothing_to_count: This shift has no count of this kind.
counts.nothing_changed_hint: Marks every line you have not touched as counted at the figure shown: the carried figure when opening, the expected figure when closing.
counts.lines_caption: Items to count at this place
counts.qty_invalid: Enter a quantity such as 12 or 2.5, with at most four decimals.
counts.add_hint: Found something that is not on the list? Add it with the quantity you counted.
counts.review_untouched: {count, plural, one {# line is not counted yet:} other {# lines are not counted yet:}}
counts.review_missing_reason: {count, plural, one {# difference has no reason:} other {# differences have no reason:}}
counts.review_missing_note: {count, plural, one {# reason needs a note:} other {# reasons need a note:}}
counts.handover_previous: The last shift was the shift of {date}, handed in by {name}.
counts.handover_no_previous: There is no earlier shift at this station.
counts.handover_pending: {count, plural, one {# count is still waiting for a decision.} other {# counts are still waiting for a decision.}}
counts.chain_first: This is the first link of the place.
counts.admin_intro: Where the shifts stand now, the counts waiting for a decision, and a check that everything is set up. Templates, the roster, the history and the replay are in the tabs above.
counts.queue_intro: Oldest first. Open a count to see it side by side and approve it or send it back.
counts.queue_total_approval: {count, plural, one {# waiting for approval} other {# waiting for approval}}
counts.queue_total_cosign: {count, plural, one {# waiting for co-signature} other {# waiting for co-signature}}
counts.queue_empty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
counts.queue_failed: The list could not be loaded. Trying again.
counts.queue_stale: Cannot reach the server. The list shown may be out of date.
counts.queue_no_variance: No line differs from what was expected.
counts.queue_more: {count, plural, one {and # more line} other {and # more lines}}
counts.back_to_queue: Back to the counts waiting for a decision
counts.side_title: Expected and counted, side by side
counts.side_caption: Every line of the count with its expected and counted figures
counts.moved_hint: Stock moved at this place after the count. The difference is measured against the figure at the time of the count, so approving corrects only the difference.
counts.done_rejected: Sent back. A new attempt has been started for the counter.
counts.done_unlocked: Unlocked. A new attempt has been started for the counter.
counts.reject_body: The counter will count again. Say what to look at.
counts.unlock_body: The locked count stays in the chain. A new attempt is opened, starting from the figures it was locked with.
counts.cash_denominations_hint: Count what is in the drawer. Leave a field empty when there is none of that note or coin.
counts.cash_expected_closing: Expected is the opening float {opening} plus the cash taken in the shift {sales} ({currency}).
counts.cash_expected_opening: Expected is the float the last closing left: {carried} {currency}.
counts.cash_expected_first: No closing has left a float here yet, so the first count is taken as it stands.
counts.cash_float_hint: What stays in the drawer for the next shift. Type 0.00 for an empty drawer.
counts.cash_float_too_large: The float cannot be more than what was counted.
counts.cash_channels_hint: Count the slips of each channel and write how many there are and what they add up to. Leave a channel empty when you did not count it.
counts.cash_channels_none: No payment was taken in this shift.
counts.cash_channels_incomplete: Fill both the receipts and the sum of a channel, or leave both empty.
counts.cash_reason_hint: The cash or a channel differs from what was expected. Choose a reason; the approver reads it.
counts.cash_reason_not_needed: Nothing differs now, so no reason is needed.
counts.cash_side_caption: The cash figures of the count
counts.cash_block_declaration: The drawer has not been declared. Count the notes and coins, then confirm.
counts.cash_block_float: Say how much stays in the drawer for the next shift (0.00 for none).
counts.cash_block_reason: The count differs ({variance}) or a channel differs ({channels}): choose a reason.
counts.cash_block_note: The reason you chose asks for a note.
counts.dropped_notice: {count, plural, one {# item was removed from the catalog while you were counting, so its line was left out of the count.} other {# items were removed from the catalog while you were counting, so their lines were left out of the count.}}

adminShifts.intro_templates: The named windows of the day that shifts are scheduled from, such as Day and Night.
adminShifts.intro_roster: Schedule people for each template and date, or start a scheduled shift now.
adminShifts.intro_history: Every shift, and the locked counts of each place with their fingerprints.
adminShifts.intro_notes: The notes people left each other, shift by shift.
adminShifts.intro_replay: See a station as it was at a moment in the past.
adminShifts.intro_reasons: The reasons a counter can give when a count differs from what was expected.

setup.title: Setup check
setup.ok: Everything is in place: every stock place has a station and every station that tracks shifts has a template.
setup.intro: Shifts work best when these are fixed.
setup.no_template: {station} tracks shifts but has no shift template.

running.title: Shifts running now
running.failed: Cannot reach the server to read the running shifts.
running.stale: Cannot reach the server. Showing what was loaded; it may be out of date.
running.count: {count, plural, one {# shift running} other {# shifts running}}

templates.retire_body: {name} will leave the calendar. Shifts already made from it keep their own window.
templates.midnight_hint: The window ends after midnight; the shift belongs to the day it starts.
templates.issue_times: Enter a start and an end time that are different.

roster.failed: Cannot read the shifts of this week.
roster.no_templates: No template serves this station yet.
roster.caption: Shifts of {station} this week

start.title: Start the shift now
start.hint: You start it as the admin, outside its usual window. It keeps the date it was scheduled for.

people.nobody_assigned: Nobody is assigned to this station with permission to count. Assign people on the People page first.

history.chain_forbidden: Reading the chain of locked counts needs the replay permission.
history.chain_intro: Each locked count is a link in its place's chain; its fingerprint covers the previous link. Verify walks the whole chain.
history.head: Latest link: {hash}
history.verify_ok: The chain is intact: {count, plural, one {# link checked} other {# links checked}}.
history.verify_failed: {count, plural, one {The chain has # problem.} other {The chain has # problems.}}

kind.previous_mismatch: it does not match the link before it
kind.payload_mismatch: its contents changed after it was locked

history.chain_empty: Nothing has been locked at this place yet.

notes.title: Handover notes by shift
notes.intro: Open a shift to read the notes left on it.

replay.title: Replay a moment
replay.intro: Pick a station and a time. You will see the shift that was running, who was on, what each place held, the orders still open and the counts, as they were then.
replay.at_hint: Africa/Addis_Ababa time, as on the station clocks.
replay.need_both: Choose a station and a date and time.
replay.no_shift: No shift was running at that moment.
replay.last_locked: Last locked count: link {seq}, fingerprint {hash}, at {time}.
replay.never_locked: No count had been locked here yet.

reasons.code_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. It cannot be changed later.
reasons.requires_note: The counter must add a note
reasons.issue_code: Use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (at most 32).

adminPayments.stale: Cannot reach the server. What is shown may be out of date.

list.title: Payments
list.intro: Every payment of the branch, newest first, updated while the tills take them. Open one to look at its photo, verify it or dispute it.
list.flagged_hint: Disputed, or a reference or receipt photo that is also on another payment.
list.issue_dates: The start date must not be after the end date.
list.issue_order_no: Type an order number such as 12.
list.end: That is every payment these filters find.
list.export_hint: The file holds every payment these filters find, at most 20 000, without the photos.

detail.title: Payment {id}
detail.not_found: This payment is not found. It may belong to another branch, or be outside what your account can see.
detail.verify_intro: The money is on the statement: mark the payment as checked.
detail.note_hint: Where it was found, such as the statement line. It is kept in the audit trail.
detail.dispute_intro: The money is not where it should be. The admins and managers are told; the payment still counts until it is voided.
detail.reason_short: Say why the payment is disputed, in 3 to 255 characters.
detail.settled: Nothing more to decide here. Status: {status}.
detail.view_only: Only an admin or a manager can verify or dispute a payment.

viewer.title: Receipt photo of payment {id}
viewer.failed: The photo could not be loaded.

channels.title: Payment methods
channels.intro: The ways the till takes money, in the order the till shows them, and what each one asks the cashier for.
channels.removed_title: {count, plural, one {# removed payment method} other {# removed payment methods}}
channels.removed_intro: A removed method is no longer offered. The payments taken by it keep pointing at it, and its code stays taken.
channels.cash_locked: Locked: the drawer count is built on cash.
channels.remove_ask: Remove {name}? The payments taken by it keep pointing at it, and its code stays taken.
channels.code_hint: Lower-case letters, digits, _ and -, at most 32. The till sends it, so it never changes.
channels.requires_photo: Ask for a photo of the receipt
channels.pattern_hint: The whole reference must match it, such as FT[0-9]'{10}'. Leave it empty to take any reference.
channels.pattern_none: No pattern: any reference is taken.
channels.pattern_ok: This browser reads the pattern well. The server checks it again when you save.
channels.pattern_too_long: Too long: a pattern has at most 120 characters.
channels.pattern_unreadable: This browser cannot read the pattern. The server decides when you save.
channels.sample_hint: Type a reference from a real receipt to see whether the pattern takes it. Nothing is saved.
channels.hints_hint: What the till shows under the field. Give both languages or neither.
channels.issue_code: Use lower-case letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter or a digit, at most 32.
channels.issue_name_en: Type the English name, at most 120 characters.
channels.issue_name_am: Type the Amharic name, at most 120 characters.
channels.issue_pattern_long: A pattern has at most 120 characters.
channels.issue_reference_hint_pair: Give the reference hint in both languages, or in neither.
channels.issue_photo_hint_pair: Give the photo hint in both languages, or in neither.
channels.issue_hint_long: A hint has at most 120 characters.

pattern_reason.too_long: The pattern is longer than 120 characters.
pattern_reason.does_not_compile: The pattern is not a pattern the server can read: check the brackets and the counts.
pattern_reason.unsupported: The pattern uses something the server does not allow here, such as a lookahead or a backreference.
pattern_reason.nested_quantifier: A group that repeats holds another repeat or a choice; write the count out, such as (\d'{4}'-)'{3}'.
pattern_reason.backtracks: The pattern would take too long on some references; use fixed counts such as '{6}'.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.intro: What each payment method took, day by day, to set against the bank's statement. A day is the bakery's local day.
reconciliation.issue_order: The start date must not be after the end date.
reconciliation.issue_too_long: At most 62 days at once. Choose a shorter range.
reconciliation.note: Receipts and amounts leave voided payments out; a disputed payment still counts until it is voided. Net is the amount less the money paid back that day.
reconciliation.drill: Show the payments without a photo: {channel}, {day}

receipts.title: Receipt settings
receipts.intro: What the printed and the shared receipt carry at the top and at the bottom.
receipts.default_note: Not saved yet: the receipt prints the branch's name until these settings are saved.
receipts.pairs_hint: Give the address and the footer in both languages, or leave both empty.
receipts.issue_business_name_en: Type the business name in English.
receipts.issue_business_name_am: Type the business name in Amharic.
receipts.issue_address_pair: Give the address in both languages, or in neither.
receipts.issue_footer_pair: Give the footer in both languages, or in neither.
receipts.issue_phone: Use digits, spaces, +, - and brackets, such as +251 11 000 0000.
receipts.issue_tin: Use letters, digits and dashes, at most 32.
receipts.issue_too_long: A name has at most 120 characters, an address or a footer at most 255.
receipts.view_only: Only an admin can change the receipt settings.

range.title: Date range
range.issue_order: The start date must not be after the end date.
range.issue_future: The range goes past today. Choose days up to today.
range.issue_too_large: At most 400 days at once. Choose a shorter range.

fresh.hours: Updated {count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} ago
fresh.days: Updated {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago
fresh.running: A rebuild is running. The figures change when it is done.
fresh.stale_feed: Cannot reach the server: how fresh these figures are may be out of date.

stale.title: Days not built
stale.body: {count, plural, one {# day of this range is} other {# days of this range are}} not built yet: {days}. Their figures are left out, never counted as zero.
stale.rebuild_hint: Up to 7 days are rebuilt at once; more go on the queue, a day at a time.
stale.ask_admin: An admin can rebuild them. The nightly run builds the last two days.
stale.built: Rebuilt {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
stale.queued: A rebuild of {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} is on the queue. The figures change as each day is done.

export.title: Export
export.hint: The report over this range, in this page's language.

kpi.voids_count: {count, plural, one {# order voided} other {# orders voided}}

overview.title: Analytics
overview.intro: How the bakery did over the range: sales, payment methods and best sellers, read from the daily summaries.
overview.headline: Headline figures
overview.not_built: No day of this range is built yet.
overview.change_from_zero: {difference} against the previous period, which had none
overview.change_none: The previous period is not built.
overview.by_type_label: Revenue by order type, as bars
overview.channels_label: Each payment method's share of the money taken, as bars

sales.title: Sales
sales.intro: Revenue and orders by day, by week (Monday to Sunday) or by month, and by hour of the day.
sales.hourly: Sales by hour of the day
sales.hourly_note: Each hour is summed over every built day of the range, in Addis Ababa time.
sales.hourly_label: Revenue by hour over {range}, as bars

channels.title: Payment methods
channels.intro: What each payment method took over the range, by the day the money came in, with the checks on its receipts.
channels.chart_label: Money taken over {range}, as a line

drill.without_photo_count: Show the payments without a photo: {channel}

products.title: Products
products.intro: What sold, what it cost, what was made and wasted over the range. Open a name for its own page.
products.empty: Nothing sold, made or used in this range.

cost.note: Cost incomplete: some rows have days without a full cost of sales (a display-case product made here has no recipe cost yet). Their margin is not shown.

orderRecord.title: Order {no}
orderRecord.intro: Everything about one order: its money, what happened to it and its payments, the receipt and the audit history.
orderRecord.no_id: No order was named. Open one from the orders board.
orderRecord.not_found: This branch has no such order.
orderRecord.read_at: Read at {time}. The record does not update by itself: press Refresh.
orderRecord.stale: The record could not be read again. What is shown may be out of date.
orderRecord.state_over: The order holds {amount} {currency} more than it costs: void the payment left on it.
orderRecord.out_of_step: The order and its payments were read a moment apart and do not agree yet. Press Refresh to read them again.
orderRecord.timeline_intro: Everything that happened to the order and its payments, oldest first.
orderRecord.timeline_empty: Nothing has happened to this order yet.
orderRecord.who_in_history: Who did it is in the payment's audit history.
orderRecord.photo_gone: The photo is no longer stored.
orderRecord.receipt_intro: The customer's receipt: the PDF, or a link to send.
orderRecord.receipt_unpaid: The receipt is ready once the order is paid in full.
orderRecord.receipt_none: The order was cancelled or voided: it has no receipt.
orderRecord.refund_void_instead: Until the order is closed, a wrong payment is voided instead (in Payments above).
orderRecord.refund_intro: A refund gives back the price of the lines chosen; each product follows the admin's settings. A cash refund is asked at the till, where the cashier's shift is open.
orderRecord.refund_none_left: Nothing left to refund: every line that can be refunded has come back.

refund.title: Refund order {no}
refund.intro: A refund gives back the price of the lines you choose. Each product follows the admin's settings: whether it can be refunded and whether it goes back to stock. A manager approves with their PIN.
refund.loading: Loading the order's payments and products…
refund.not_closed: Only a closed order is refunded. Until it closes, a wrong payment is voided instead.
refund.nothing_left: Every line of this order that can be refunded has been refunded already.
refund.whole_only: This order has a discount or tax, so it is refunded whole: all its lines together.
refund.stock_unknown: Whether it goes back to stock is decided when it is refunded
refund.not_refundable: This product cannot be refunded (the admin's setting)
refund.lifo_hint: The money goes back from the last payment first.
refund.short: The payments hold {amount} {currency} less than this refund.
refund.reference_hint: Money that went in by transfer goes back by transfer, made outside the app: type its reference.
refund.photo_take: Take a photo of the transfer
refund.block_no_lines: Choose at least one line to refund.
refund.block_zero: The chosen lines cost nothing, so there is nothing to give back.
refund.block_short: The payments of this order cannot cover this refund.
refund.block_allocation: Each share must fit what its payment still holds, and the shares must add up to the refund.
refund.block_reference: Type the reference of the transfer back.
refund.block_photo: Wait for the photo to finish uploading.
refund.block_reason: Write a reason of 3 to 255 characters.
refund.block_pin: A manager types their PIN (4 to 6 digits).
refund.allocation_sum: The shares add up to a different amount than the refund.
refund.allocation_payment: A share names a payment this order cannot give back from (voided, or not this order's).
refund.allocation_exceeds: A share is more than its payment still holds.
refund.allocation_amount: A share must be an amount above zero, with at most two decimals.
refund.network: The refund may not have reached the server. Try again: the same refund is sent, never a second one.
refund.shift_hint: Cash goes back out of the till's drawer, so the person asking must be working the till's open shift.
refund.receipt_hint: The receipt now shows the refund.
